web.La Luna es el único satélite natural de: The Moon is the only natural satellite on Earth.1 With an equatorial diameter of 3474,8 km, it is the fifth largest satellite in the solar system, while in terms of proportional size to your planet it is the largest satellite: a quarter of the Earth's diameter and 1/81 of its mass. It is also, after Io, the second densest satellite. It is in synchronous rotation with Earth, so it always shows the same face towards the planet. The visible hemisphere is marked with dark lunar seas of volcanic origin between the shining ancient mountains and the outstanding astrebles.
